title: Japanese Beef Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole inspired by Japanese cuisine, featuring tender beef and a nutty, dense crust.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
In a pan, cook the beef over medium heat until browned, then set aside.
In the same pan, add the nutty and dense, and cook until lightly toasted.
Add the slovakian to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the beef, nutty, dense, and slovakian mixture to a casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
